# H A V N & COMPANY (Amol Gupta & Associates)

> Leading Chartered Accountant (CA) firm in New Delhi, India. Providing expert services in Tax Planning, Audit & Assurance, Corporate Compliance, NRI Financial Advisory, Company Formation, Bank Financing, and Business Software Consultancy.

## Overview
Founded in 2013 by CA Amol Gupta, H A V N & COMPANY (Amol Gupta & Associates) is a premier Chartered Accountancy firm committed to professional excellence, statutory compliance, and ethical financial strategies. We serve Indian startups, established corporations, non-resident Indians (NRIs), and global enterprises.

## Primary Pages & Information
- [Home](https://agaassociates-website.pages.dev/): Comprehensive overview of CA consulting services, practice areas, leadership, and firm contact info.
- [About Us](https://agaassociates-website.pages.dev/about-us/): Detailed history, firm vision, mission statement, core principles, and executive leadership background.
- [Services](https://agaassociates-website.pages.dev/services/): Full breakdown of auditing, direct and indirect taxation, corporate compliance, and advisory services.
- [Our Teams](https://agaassociates-website.pages.dev/our-teams/): Leadership profiles of CA Hukam Chand Jindal (Executive Chairman), CA Amol Gupta (Founder & Managing Partner), and senior partners.
- [Articles & News](https://agaassociates-website.pages.dev/article/): Statutory tax notifications, regulatory updates, audit guidelines, and business finance articles.
- [Contact Us](https://agaassociates-website.pages.dev/contact/): Office locations, telephone details, email contact, and consultation request form.

## Key Specialized Consultancy Services
- [Company Formation](https://agaassociates-website.pages.dev/other-consultancy-services/company-formation/): Registration and incorporation of Private Limited Companies, LLPs, One Person Companies (OPC), and Partnership firms in India.
- [Bank Loan and Finance Services](https://agaassociates-website.pages.dev/other-consultancy-services/bank-loan-and-finance-services/): Project finance, working capital loans, CMA data preparation, project reports, and loan syndication.
- [Financial Advisory Services](https://agaassociates-website.pages.dev/other-consultancy-services/financial-advisory-services/): Corporate restructuring, capital planning, risk assessment, valuation, and wealth management.
- [NRI Services & ITR of NRI](https://agaassociates-website.pages.dev/other-consultancy-services/nri-services-itr-of-nri/): Non-Resident Indian tax filing, FEMA compliance, 15CA & 15CB certifications, foreign asset reporting, and repatriation advice.
- [Business Software Consultancy](https://agaassociates-website.pages.dev/other-consultancy-services/business-software-consultancy/): Implementation, setup, and support for accounting software (Tally, Zoho Books, ERP) and compliance automation tools.
